The threat actor conducted reconnaissance via an Nmap scan against an internal IT asset (WS-IT-101 at 10.0.2.15), which was later used as a pivot point to successfully authenticate to 23 accounts in the Finance OU using pass-the-hash techniques. SIEM analysis confirms 23 successful logins from j.martinez account originating from malicious IP. Lateral access to multiple accounts identified.
Containment actions (credential revocation) attempted but denied due to lack of approval workflow execution.
Full endpoint scan on WS-IT-101 (10.0.2.15) completed with no threats detected.

title: Suspicious rundll32 Execution from User Temp Directory
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\\rundll32.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\'
      - '\\Users\\\\.*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\'
  condition: selection
level: high
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1218/011/
description: Detects rundll32 loading DLLs from the user's Temp directory, commonly used for living-off-the-land and malware execution.
